zh.title: 新功能
items: **MCP 管理页焕新**：MCP 连接改为卡片式布局，点击卡片从右侧滑出详情抽屉，可查看连接状态、管理工具开关与凭证，与技能页体验一致。

zh.title: 优化
items: **MCP OAuth 配置大幅简化**：检测到连接需要认证时自动切换为 OAuth 2.0；回调地址改为只读展示（不再需要手填）；授权端点支持自动发现，多数情况无需手动配置。
**统一的操作确认弹窗**：删除等危险操作的确认框改用应用内统一样式，替换系统原生弹窗。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复移除 MCP 连接后重新添加会残留重复凭证的问题。
新增流式输出复读检测：模型陷入异常复读时自动收口本轮，避免持续消耗。

en.title: What's New
items: **MCP management page refresh**: MCP connections use a card layout; open a card to slide out a right detail drawer for connection status, tool toggles, and credentials—aligned with the skills page.

en.title: Improvements
items: **Much simpler MCP OAuth setup**: When a connection needs auth, it switches to OAuth 2.0 automatically; callback URL is read-only (no hand-fill); authorization endpoints support discovery so most cases need no manual config.
**Unified confirm dialogs**: Dangerous actions like delete use the in-app confirm style instead of native system alerts.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed leftover duplicate credentials when removing and re-adding an MCP connection.
Added stream repetition detection: if the model loops abnormally, the turn is closed early to avoid runaway spend.
